Messages.Author: Sten During
Messages.Body:
The Anarch expansion is going to add some new rules and I wonder
when they go in effect.

The on-line rules for example talk about seven Camarilla clans
in the base set (including Gangrel), but Gangrel will have their
default sect changed to independent.

The reason for the question is that there is a need to know for
the prerelasetournaments as well as any limited format tournament
held within a short time from the release.

Sten During

Messages.Author: Kevin M.
Messages.Body:


The tournament rules state:

4.3. NEW RELEASES
New V:TES cards (new expansions, new editions of the basic set, and
promotional cards) are allowed in Constructed tournament play beginning
30 days after their retail release date. V:EKN announcements confirm the
exact date that each new card set enters tournament play before the set
is released. New cards are allowed in Limited tournament play
immediately, including before the release date (for example, at a
Prerelease tournament).

The scheduled release date for Anarchs is May 19, 2003.

>
> Sten During

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Sten During wrote:
> The Anarch expansion is going to add some new rules and I wonder
> when they go in effect.

When the set is legal for play.
For contructed tournaments, this is 30 days after the official release.

> The on-line rules for example talk about seven Camarilla clans
> in the base set (including Gangrel), but Gangrel will have their
> default sect changed to independent.
>
> The reason for the question is that there is a need to know for
> the prerelasetournaments as well as any limited format tournament
> held within a short time from the release.

Prerelease tournaments are not sanctioned, so don't have to follow
the V:EKN rules for when changes become official. Given the nature
of the prerelease tournament, it is clear that the rules for the
set being prereleased will apply.

Limited formats that use the set will use the rules that come with
the set.
